description: Which Italian comuni match: region, province, population range, purchase-price and rent ranges (OMI), population change 2019–2025, and/or the verified comuni of a tax regime. Paged (max 100) and sortable. A comune with no price, rent or population-change figure is left out of the filter on it and COUNTED in `missingData` — never treated as cheap, free or stable; say how many were left out. The taxRegime filter lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes: a comune missing from it is NOT a 'no' (the response says so in `taxRegime.note`). Rows carry plain numbers; their source and vintage are in `figures`. Use search_comuni to turn a town name into a code, get_comune for one town's full profile.

maxPopulationChangePct.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive.

maxPurchasePriceEurM2.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

maxRentEurM2Month.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

minPopulationChangePct.description: Population change 2019 to 2025, in percent, inclusive. A negative value means decline.

minPurchasePriceEurM2.description: Purchase price in EUR/m2, inclusive. A comune with no price is left out, never treated as cheap.

minRentEurM2Month.description: Rent in EUR/m2 per month, inclusive. A comune with no rent figure is left out.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page.

order.description: Default: desc for population and populationChange, asc for name, purchasePrice and rent.

province.description: A province's two-letter code ("AQ") or slug ("l-aquila").

q.description: Only comuni whose name contains this (case- and accent-insensitive).

region.description: A region name or slug, e.g. "Abruzzo" or "valle-d-aosta".

sort.description: Sort key. A comune without a figure for the sort key always sorts last.

taxRegime.description: A verified geographic regime slug from /tax/regimes. Lists only comuni on the regime's verified routes; a comune missing from the list is NOT a "no" (the rule may admit comuni by routes not yet encoded).
